assessment.question:
### Exercise 5.6: Use a number line to subtract integers

3. $5-(-6)$
assessment.expected_answer:
$$
\require{enclose}5\,\enclose{circle}[mathcolor="red"]{-}(-6)
$$

![](https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/ebw-jss1-05-019.png)

5 lies to the positive side of $-6$.

$$
\therefore 5-(-6)=11
$$
